title: The KGB gives the Tsar's box seat to Malmgren instead of Kissinger

tellings.quote: Zar and one of the KB people said, "Henry, not tonight. Not tonight. That seat is for Dr. Mal.

plain: Harald Malmgren, a former adviser to US presidents, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a night in Moscow around 1982. He says that at an event there, men from the KGB, the Soviet secret police, told former US secretary of state Henry Kissinger that the old Tsar's box seat was not for him that night but for "Dr. Mal." He tells it to show how much standing he says he had with the Soviets.
